body:
# 🖱️ EasyButtons

**Elevate your server's interactables with professional, animated, and customizable 3D display buttons.**

Tired of using basic blocks or invisible armor stands? **EasyButtons** leverages modern **Display Entities** (1.21.1+) to create stylish, angled consoles and floating button interfaces. Designed for high-end server networks, it brings a clean, "modded" look to vanilla Minecraft.

---

## 🔥 Features

* **⚡ Smooth Click Animation:** Buttons physically push down when interacted with, providing high-quality visual feedback.
* **📏 Perfect Alignment:** Buttons are automatically centered and tilted at a **30-degree angle**, perfect for control desks and consoles.
* **🔊 Built-in Audio:** Includes satisfying click sounds to enhance the tactile feel.
* **💻 Command Power:** Link unlimited console or player commands to any button using a simple ID system.
* **🛡️ Precision Hitboxes:** Optimized interaction entities ensure that the clickable area perfectly matches the 3D model.
* **🍃 Lightweight:** High performance with zero lag, using modern engine features instead of legacy entities.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/eb help` | Shows all available commands. | `easybuttons.admin` |
| `/eb create <id> <material>` | Spawns a new button at your location. | `easybuttons.admin` |
| `/eb reload` | Reloads the configuration file instantly. | `easybuttons.admin` |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration Example

Assigning actions to your buttons is simple. Just edit the `config.yml`:

```yaml
buttons:
  spawn_teleport:
    commands:
      - "tp %player% 0 64 0"
      - "msg %player% §aWelcome to the Spawn!"
      - "playsound entity.enderman.teleport master %player%"
